title: The Other Acute Migraine Drug: Effect on a Quantity Limit Renewal Ceiling
content:
The approval ceiling of a quantity limit renewal is worked out only after the records carry the authorization owed for every appeal overturned on the other acute migraine drug.

Under the Utilization Management Program, the other acute migraine drug is Ubrelvy for a sumatriptan renewal and sumatriptan for a Ubrelvy renewal; a Nurtec ODT renewal has none, and is renewed under the same terms without this adjustment.

**Rule.** The other acute migraine drug changes how the renewal approval ceiling is worked out from the drug's limit times the multiple as already worked out for concurrent opioid use (the result of the opioid step):

1. when the member holds a quantity limit authorization for the other drug in force on the decision date with an approved quantity **above that drug's limit**, one quarter of that approved quantity is subtracted;
2. when the member holds such an authorization **at or below that drug's limit**, or has **at least one paid retail fill of the other drug** dated within the last three months, the result is multiplied by 0.95;
3. otherwise it is used as it stands.

The other drug's limit is 16 units for Ubrelvy and 9 units for sumatriptan per rolling 30 days. The authorization read is the member's quantity limit authorization for the other drug with the latest effective date, counted when its last day in force is on or after the decision date. The fills are paid retail claims under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit; the three months end on the decision date, a fill counting when dated after the same day of the month three months before it.

## Cases (hypothetical; result of the opioid step 13.5 on a sumatriptan renewal)

| Ubrelvy quantity limit authorization in force | Paid Ubrelvy retail fills in three months | Result |
|---|---|---|
| approved 24 (above the limit of 16) | any | 13.5 less one quarter of 24, that is 6: 7.5 |
| approved 16 (at the limit) | any | 13.5 multiplied by 0.95: 12.825 |
| none | 2 | 12.825 |
| none | 0 | 13.5 |
